slides.title: POV: your cousin is opening a Christmas tree lot
Trees arrive Friday. 300 of them.
slides.body: Meanwhile: the seasonal permit, the tent permit and the insurance for the lot.

slides.title: "The landlord asked for a COI. Is that a type of tree?"
slides.body: It is not a type of tree. It's proof your insurance is current.

slides.title: Seasonal business, same paperwork.
slides.body: CertTrack keeps every permit and policy date in one place and alerts you before it expires.
